questions.question: What is the duration of the program if starting after grade 9?
questions.answer: The standard duration of study is 2 years and 10 months.

questions.question: What is the duration of the program if starting after grade 11?
questions.answer: The standard duration of study is 1 year and 10 months (with knowledge of English). The standard duration of study is 2 years and 10 months (without knowledge of English).

questions.question: What subjects are included in the entrance exams?
questions.answer: Entrance exams in mathematics, English, and an essay (in Kyrgyz/Russian).

questions.question: What language is used for instruction at the college?
questions.answer: The language of instruction is English. The first year of the program will be conducted in Russian. The second and third years will be conducted in English.

questions.question: What is the cost of the tuition fee?
questions.answer: The tuition cost is $4000, with an initial payment of 30% required. For more detailed information about the tuition fee, please reach out to the admissions office. Contact us at: 0501 990 550.

questions.question: What is covered by the tuition fee?
questions.answer: Along with tuition, each student receives a new corporate access subscription to internal educational platforms, a corporate license for Coursera.org (starting from the second year), licenses for other products, and a personal laptop.

questions.question: Does the tuition fee include meals and accommodation?
questions.answer: No, the college does not provide accommodation or meals.

questions.question: Will the tuition fee change during the study?
questions.answer: The tuition fee that you agreed upon at enrollment will remain unchanged throughout the entire standard duration of study.

questions.question: Can I work with a diploma received after successfully completing the program?
questions.answer: Upon successful completion, graduates receive a diploma of secondary vocational education. You can work in your chosen field with the diploma or continue your studies at a university from the second year.

questions.question: Can graduates find job opportunities abroad?
questions.answer: Yes, after graduation, you can seek employment in Germany and Japan, as long as you have at least a B1 level in German or Japanese and maintain an academic performance of over 85 out of 100.

questions.question: What diploma is awarded upon graduation?
questions.answer: After graduation, a diploma of secondary vocational education is awarded.

questions.question: I don’t have a strong knowledge of English, can I study at your college?
questions.answer: Upon admission, each student takes an English exam. Based on the results, we determine the level of language proficiency and place students into appropriate groups. In addition to the 10th-11th grade subjects, there will be an intensified study of English.

questions.question: What is the study schedule?
questions.answer: The classes are held from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Monday - Friday)

about.title: Light Academy
about.description: Light Academy (L.A.) is an educational brand that began its journey in 2018 and currently operates five international schools across different regions of Kyrgyzstan. This year, Light Academy is opening a new engineering college in Bishkek — E|C Engineering College.
about.overviewDescription:
E|C Engineering College is a modern institution focused on educating future engineers, designers, and technology leaders. Located in the heart of a vibrant urban environment, the college provides a learning space where innovation, creativity, and practical knowledge come together. We combine strong academic foundations with hands-on experience, modern facilities, and digital learning tools to help students turn ideas into real solutions.

At E|C, education goes beyond classrooms. Students learn by doing—through projects, research, collaboration, and engagement with real-world challenges. Our programs are designed to adapt to the rapidly changing world of technology while remaining grounded in ethical responsibility and sustainable development.
about.missionDescription: Our mission is to educate, support, and inspire the next generation of engineers and technologists. We aim to equip students with the technical skills, critical thinking abilities, and creative mindset needed to solve complex industry challenges. Through practical learning, strong mentorship, and a values-driven approach, we prepare students to build solutions that are innovative, responsible, and meaningful for society.
about.visionDescription:
At E|C Engineering College, we envision a future where our graduates play an active role in shaping technological progress around the world. We strive to become a globally recognized institution known for excellence in engineering education, applied research, and industry collaboration.

Our vision is to create an open and inclusive academic community where creativity is encouraged, diversity is valued, and collaboration drives innovation. By fostering curiosity, leadership, and a commitment to sustainability, we aim to prepare students not only for successful careers, but also for lifelong learning and positive impact in an ever-evolving global society.

softwareEngineering.name: Software Engineering
description: The Software Engineering Program is designed to prepare students for careers in software development by combining strong theoretical foundations with hands-on experience. Students learn how to design, build, test, and maintain scalable software systems using modern programming languages, frameworks, and development tools.

The program emphasizes problem-solving, system thinking, and teamwork, while introducing students to software development methodologies, version control, and project management practices. Graduates are equipped to work in fast-paced technology environments and contribute to real-world software solutions.

cyberSecurity.name: Cybersecurity
description: The Cybersecurity Program prepares students to protect digital systems and information in an increasingly connected world. Through practical training and real-world scenarios, students learn how to identify vulnerabilities, prevent cyberattacks, and secure networks and data.

The program covers areas such as ethical hacking, network security, cryptography, and risk management. Graduates gain the skills needed to respond to security threats and ensure the integrity of digital systems across various industries.

management.name: Management
description: The Management Program prepares students to lead teams, manage projects, and make strategic decisions in a business environment. The program combines core business knowledge with practical skills in leadership, communication, and organizational management.
Students learn how to plan, execute, and evaluate projects, work with teams, and adapt to changing business environments. Graduates are ready to take on leadership roles across different industries.

design.name: Design
description: The Design Program focuses on developing creative and technical skills to create visual and digital products. Students learn to design user-centered solutions by combining creativity, design principles, and modern tools.
The program covers areas such as graphic design, digital design, branding, and user experience (UX/UI). Graduates are prepared to work on real-world design projects across different industries.

marketing.name: Marketing
description: The Marketing Program prepares students to promote products and services in a competitive market. Students learn how to analyze consumer behavior, build brands, and develop effective marketing strategies using digital tools and platforms.
The program focuses on digital marketing, social media, content creation, and data-driven decision-making. Graduates are equipped to work in modern marketing environments and drive business growth.

academics.reasonsTitle: 7 Reasons to Study at E|C College of Engineering

reasons.description: E|C College of Engineering offers a hybrid education model, combining in-person learning with digital resources and flexible formats. In addition to core academic programs, we provide preparation courses for IELTS, TOEFL, SAT, and other language-based exams, as well as guidance and support for students planning to study abroad.

Our students do not simply memorize material—they understand it through practice. Learning is built around real projects, problem-solving, and applied tasks guided by experienced and highly engaged instructors. Our teaching approach ensures that theory is always connected to real-world application.

description.text: E|C College of Engineering offers focused programs designed around the most in-demand skills in the global job market. Each program emphasizes depth, specialization, and practical relevance, preparing students for immediate career entry or further academic growth. Our programs include:
list: Software Engineering: Front-end, Back-end, Full-stack, Mobile Application Development
Cybersecurity: Security Engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps
Management in IT: IT Project Management, Business Analytics, Digital Strategy, Technology Leadership
Industrial Design: Product Design, CAD & Prototyping, User Experience, Sustainable Design

reasons.keywords: Outstanding Faculty as Our Core Strength
reasons.description: The main value of E|C College of Engineering is its faculty. Most of our instructors hold PhD degrees in their respective fields and combine strong academic backgrounds with real industry and research experience. Students learn directly from experts who actively mentor, guide, and inspire them.

Our college maintains close collaboration with local and international companies, enabling students to participate in internships, industry-driven projects, competitions, and professional networking opportunities that support career development.

Inclusiveness, support, and respect are at the core of our values. E|C College of Engineering provides a safe and welcoming environment where students receive academic guidance, mentoring, and personal support, allowing them to grow with confidence both academically and personally.

reasons.keywords: Active Student Life and Community Engagement
reasons.description: Students actively participate in extracurricular and competitive activities such as Enactus, ICPC, hackathons, innovation challenges, research projects, and community initiatives. These experiences strengthen leadership, teamwork, and professional skills beyond the classroom.

graduationDocuments.title: Graduation Documents
list: Diploma of secondary vocational education: The main document confirming the receipt of secondary vocational education in a specific specialty. It can be with honors (red diploma) or without honors (blue diploma), depending on the student's performance.
Diploma supplement: This document lists all the subjects the student studied and the grades received. The supplement is an integral part of the diploma.

Certificates: Depending on the training program and additional courses, the student may receive various certificates. These may include certificates for completing advanced training courses or certificates of specific professional skills.

scholarship.title: Scholarships, Discounts & Financial Support
intro: At E|C Engineering College, we believe that high-quality education should be accessible to talented and motivated students, regardless of their background or circumstances. To support this commitment, the College offers a range of scholarships, tuition discounts, and financial support opportunities for prospective and current students.
Our support programs are designed to recognize academic achievement, leadership potential, community involvement, and to provide assistance to families facing financial or social challenges.
scholarship.eligibilityIntro: Students may be considered for financial support under one or more of the following categories:
eligibilityList: Winners and participants of Olympiads, competitions, hackathons, and other academic or technical events
Applicants from regions across the Kyrgyz Republic
Families with multiple children enrolled at E|C Engineering College
Students demonstrating leadership, initiative, and active community involvement
Applicants who complete the admission process during the early enrollment period
Students choosing to pay tuition for the full academic year in advance
Applicants referred by E|C students, alumni, parents, or institutional partners
howToText: During the admissions process, our Admissions Team will help determine which scholarships, discounts, or financial support opportunities you may be eligible for.

Applicants may be asked to provide supporting documentation to verify eligibility for specific categories. Each application is reviewed individually based on the submitted documents and the College's current financial support policies.
importantText: The value and conditions of scholarships and discounts vary depending on the category and supporting documentation provided.

In some cases, a student may qualify for more than one category of support. The possibility of combining different forms of financial assistance is determined in accordance with the College's policies and procedures.
Please note that scholarships and discounts are not granted automatically. All awards are subject to review, verification, and formal approval by the College.
moreText: If you would like to learn more about the scholarships, discounts, and financial support opportunities available to you, please contact the Admissions Office.
Our team will be happy to guide you through the available options and help identify the forms of support for which you may be eligible.

olympiad.title: EC Young Innovators Olympiad
olympiad.subtitle: An olympiad of innovative ideas for 9th-grade students
olympiad.slogan: Come up with an idea. Prepare your project. Pitch to the jury. Build your future.
intro: EC Young Innovators Olympiad is an educational olympiad for 9th-grade students, where every participant can propose an idea aimed at solving a real problem in their school, city, region, or society.
The olympiad is organized by Engineering College in cooperation with APRD.
The main goal of the project is to help students develop creative thinking, presentation skills, self-confidence, and an interest in engineering, technology, and entrepreneurship.

forWhom.title: Who is this olympiad for?
text: The olympiad is intended for 9th-grade students.
Participation is individual. This means each participant develops their own idea, prepares a presentation, and pitches it to the jury.

theme.title: Choose an idea
theme.name: "Ideas that improve our community"
theme.intro: Find a real problem around you and propose a clear solution.

registration.title: Submit your presentation
registration.text: Fill out the form and attach your finished presentation.
registration.warning: Be careful when submitting: double-check all fields and make sure you've attached the correct presentation. It will be difficult to edit your application after submission.

selection.title: Await selection results
text: Organizers will review all applications and presentations. Selection results will be announced on July 17.
If you're confident you'll make it through — start preparing your pitch now.
selection.videoLabel: How to prepare for your pitch

workshops.title: Free workshops
workshops.text: Finalists get access to free educational workshops. Workshop topics:

items.name: How to find a good idea
items.desc: Participants learn how to notice real problems around them and choose a strong topic for their project.

items.name: How to come up with a solution
items.desc: Participants learn to turn a problem into a clear idea and build a simple prototype.

items.name: How to present a project
items.desc: Participants prepare for their pitch and learn to talk about their idea confidently and clearly.

finalPitch.title: Time to shine
finalPitch.text: The final will take place on July 29.
mentalTips: Rehearse your pitch out loud several times — ideally in front of a live audience
Learn your key phrases, but don't memorize the script word for word
Prepare answers to possible jury questions
Get a good night's sleep and arrive early — calm matters more than a perfect script

prepare.title: Prepare a presentation
prepare.text: Participants need to prepare a 5–7 slide presentation. Use the template and follow this structure:
structure: Prototype, mockup, poster, or visual idea
Why the participant chose this topic
prepare.prototypeText: You can build a prototype with AI tools:
prepare.feedbackText: Show your presentation and demo to friends, family, or classmates — gather feedback and improve your project before submitting.

criteria.title: How will projects be evaluated?
criteria.intro: The jury will evaluate projects against clear criteria:
list: how important the problem is
how creative the idea is
whether the solution can be implemented
what social impact the project may have
how well the presentation is prepared
how the participant answers questions
criteria.note: The olympiad evaluates not only knowledge, but also thinking, initiative, confidence, and the desire to solve real problems.

prizes.title: Prizes
prizes.intro: Winners receive educational discounts on tuition at Engineering College:
prizes.specialTitle: There may also be special nominations:

why.title: Why take part?
why.intro: Taking part in the olympiad is an opportunity to:
list: show your potential
gain public-speaking experience
learn to create ideas and projects
get to know Engineering College
receive feedback from experts
compete for an educational discount
take the first step toward your future profession
why.note: Even if a participant doesn't win, they gain valuable experience, new knowledge, and confidence in their abilities.

organizer.title: Who organizes it?
organizer.collaboration: The olympiad is organized by Engineering College in cooperation with
organizer.description: The project aims to develop young talent, support students, and promote innovative thinking among 9th-grade students.

banner.title: EC Young Innovators Olympiad
banner.text: 9th-graders: pitch an idea and win up to a 100% tuition scholarship.
